brand.name: Kohler
brand.category: Digital goods shop, in-house casino, and collectible avatar vault
brand.positioning: A premium, high-energy digital destination where players shop, play original games, and build a visual identity.
brand.promise: One balance. A full playground. Your look, your table, your moment.
tagline_options: Shop it. Play it. Own it.

logo.concept: An ivory vertical stem and a cut gold geometric gem form a K.
logo.primary_use: Use the full Kohler wordmark on flyers and campaign headers.
logo.compact_use: Use the geometric K mark for avatars, badges, coins, favicons, and square social assets.
logo.clear_space: Keep clear space equal to the width of the K stem on every side.
do_not: Do not stretch, skew, rotate, redraw, or add effects to the mark.
Do not place the gold mark on a low-contrast yellow background.
Do not use the mark to imply a government, banking, or licensed gaming endorsement.

usage.neon_green: Primary action, positive movement, deposits, active states, and energy.
usage.gold: Premium products, wins, rewards, VIP moments, and the geometric K.
usage.coral: Money out, warnings, risk notices, and destructive actions.
usage.obsidian_and_ink: Primary backgrounds and premium contrast surfaces.
usage.category_accents: Use supporting hues to distinguish game or shop categories without changing the core brand.

colors.contrast_rule: Use light text on dark surfaces. Use near-black text on neon green or gold buttons.

display.use: Headlines, campaign titles, game names, hero statements, and short labels.

body.use: Supporting copy, details, disclaimers, navigation, and calls to action.

numeric.use: Balances, odds, prices, limits, IDs, and technical values.

rules: Use tight tracking and compact line lengths for display headlines.
Keep body copy direct and scannable.
Never use decorative script or novelty display fonts.

visual_language.surfaces: Obsidian panels with subtle borders, rounded corners, and soft depth.
visual_language.lighting: Controlled neon green and warm gold glows against dark space.
visual_language.shapes: Rounded cards, chips, coins, geometric gems, table circles, and crisp diagonal cuts.
visual_language.imagery: Expressive, exaggerated, fully clothed characters and objects with a premium 3D or polished illustrated finish.
visual_language.composition: One dominant subject, strong negative space, a clear headline, and one primary action.
visual_language.motion_hint: Suggest momentum with streaks, sparks, falling coins, radial bursts, or a rising trajectory; keep the design legible when static.

voice.sentence_style: Use active verbs, concrete nouns, and short punchy sentences.
copy_rules: Never promise a result or imply that a player can recover losses.
Never hide fees, limits, eligibility, or jurisdictional restrictions.
Describe paid games as entertainment and include the approved responsible-play footer where applicable.
Use Bitcoin only when the specific asset is about deposits, withdrawals, or the wallet.

asset_defaults.image_prompt_suffix: Premium Kohler campaign art, obsidian background, neon green and warm gold accents, polished 3D illustration, dramatic but clean lighting, expressive subject, fully clothed and family-friendly, no text, no logos, no watermark, high contrast, clear negative space for headline.

brand_safety: No minors, nudity, sexualized content, graphic violence, hate symbols, illegal drugs, or real-person likenesses.
Do not imitate another company's logo, mascot, campaign, or proprietary visual style.
Do not fabricate partnerships, licensing, certifications, jackpots, player counts, or financial outcomes.
gambling_copy: Do not target minors or vulnerable people.
Do not suggest gambling is a solution to financial problems.
Do not describe wins as certain or losses as recoverable.
Add local age, licensing, availability, and responsible-play language before publishing.
guardrails.operational_disclaimer: Kohler's live-money features, game availability, payment methods, and legal status depend on configuration and local requirements. Confirm current details before publication.

context.purpose: Context for designer and generative-design models creating Kohler flyers, social assets, landing pages, launch graphics, and in-product promotional art.

source_of_truth.fact_policy: Use only facts in this file or facts supplied for the specific campaign. Do not invent prices, promotions, odds, legal approvals, availability, or performance claims.

brand_story.short: Kohler brings digital shopping, original casino play, and collectible self-expression into one connected destination.
brand_story.long: Kohler is an in-house digital playground built around one balance and three connected experiences. The Shop handles digital goods such as gift cards, subscriptions, and top-ups. The Casino brings together Survivor, original instant games, table games, dice, plinko, wheels, slots, blackjack, and roulette. The Vault lets players collect AI-made avatars, frames, win effects, and the Kohler Pass. The feeling is premium, immediate, expressive, and transparent.
emotional_territory: the rush of a clean result
the identity of a chosen avatar
the status of a premium collection
the confidence of a clear, self-contained experience

designer_model_prompt.base_prompt: Create a Kohler marketing flyer for {campaign}. Use the Kohler identity: obsidian dark background, neon green action accents, warm gold premium accents, Unbounded display typography, Inter body typography, geometric K mark, polished high-contrast composition, one dominant subject, strong negative space, and a clear CTA. The visual should feel premium, electric, playful, and controlled. Keep all characters fully clothed and family-friendly. Do not render text inside the image; reserve clean space for typesetting.

variables.campaign: Replace with a campaign playbook name or custom brief.
variables.headline: Add the approved headline during layout, not inside generated imagery.
variables.cta: Use one CTA from the CTA bank.
variables.subject: Use one product, avatar, table, or game as the focal subject.
variables.format: Use one of the recommended flyer sizes.

publication_checklist: Confirm the campaign's product, route, price, promotion, and availability against the live product.
Use the correct Kohler logo treatment and color tokens.
Keep one primary CTA and one dominant visual message.
Add current legal, age, licensing, jurisdiction, and responsible-play language where relevant.
Check contrast, mobile crops, safe margins, and legibility at thumbnail size.
Do not publish unsupported performance, payout, partnership, scarcity, or financial claims.
